Commuting across county lines, 2015 to 2024

67.1%

of workers living in the 21-County Modeling Support Region commuted to another county in 2024. The share rose by 2.5 percentage points since 2015, when it was 64.5%.

2,870,578resident workers in 2024
+480,481change since 2015

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES8), Georgia OD main files, JT00 (All Jobs). Analysis: Atlanta Regional Commission. Rates cover workers who live in the 21-County Modeling Support Region and hold jobs anywhere in Georgia; jobs held in other states are not included. Definitions and county list. LODES are partially synthetic, so small flows should be read with caution.
